name: memory-status
description: Whether your Supabase memory is up or degraded, and how many writes wait in its queue: a line above the prompt, and /memory-status with each container and a targeted fix.

url.title: Memory URL
url.description: The Supabase gateway. Empty finds it from your supabase-memory MCP server, else http://127.0.0.1:8100.

pendingFile.title: Pending-write queue
pendingFile.description: The pending.jsonl that degraded-mode writes wait in. Empty finds it next to your supabase-memory project.

critical.title: Containers memory needs
critical.description: Comma-separated. Any of these stopped means degraded.

onlyProblems.title: Show the line only when something is wrong
onlyProblems.description: Off shows it all the time; on hides it while memory is ok and nothing is queued.
